summary: Calisa Acquisition Corp filed an 8-K disclosing an amended and restated prepaid forward purchase agreement dated October 13, 2026, tied to its pending March 6, 2026 business combination with Goodvision AI Inc., in which Calisa Merger Sub will merge into Goodvision, leaving Goodvision a wholly owned Calisa subsidiary. Harraden Circle Investments vehicles (the Purchaser) will buy up to 3,000,000 ordinary shares at no more than the roughly $10.31 redemption price, with 50,000 commitment shares excluded, to maximize trust funds retained. Watch redemption levels and closing mechanics.
